dedupe_keys.name: webgis adbpo it flood hazard datasets

description: webgis.adbpo.it: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.adbpo.it. Coverage: the area served by webgis.adbpo.it. The listing groups 16 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Classi Rischio Aree Rischio idraulico Distretto Po 2020 (Distretto Po); Alluvioni UoM Marecchia-Conca Alluvioni marine P3 2020 (Distretto Po); Alluvioni UoM Marecchia-Conca Alluvioni marine P1 2020 (Distretto Po); Alluvioni UoM Marecchia-Conca Alluvioni marine P2 2020 (Distretto Po). Formats seen: WMS, WFS, TIFF, WCS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0), as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
